allow_bots_disabled.text: Messages from bots and webhooks will no longer be relayed from this chat.

allow_bots_enabled.text: Messages from bots and webhooks will now be relayed from this chat.

allow_files_bridge_disabled.text: Files sent in Telegram will no longer be re-uploaded to Discord for the chats of this bridge.

allow_files_bridge_enabled.text: Files sent in Telegram will now be re-uploaded to Discord and shared as links — for every chat of this bridge, including ones that join later. It works only where every chat of the bridge allows it.

allow_files_disabled.text: Files sent in Telegram will no longer be re-uploaded to Discord for the chats of this server.

allow_files_enabled.text: Files sent in Telegram will now be re-uploaded to Discord and shared as links — for every chat of this server, in any bridge. It works only where every chat of the bridge allows it.

allow_files_no_permission.text: Only Bridge Admins and Bot Admins can change the file re-upload consent.

allow_files_usage.text: Usage: /allow-files enable | /allow-files disable — for this whole server; add `local` (/allow-files enable local) for this bridge only.

allow_files_usage_tg.text: Usage: /allow_files enable | /allow_files disable — for this whole group; add `local` (/allow_files enable local) for this bridge only.

appeal_already_open.text: You already have an open appeal. Just write to me in DM — your messages reach the consuls.

appeal_already_resolved.text: This appeal has already been resolved.

appeal_confirm_condemn.text: Permanently ban the user on this server (without a database record) and close the appeal?

appeal_confirm_pardon.text: Lift ALL of this user's network bans and close the appeal?

appeal_created.text: Appeal created — check your direct messages.

appeal_created_dm.text: Your appeal has been filed. Describe your situation right here: every message you send me in DM is forwarded to the consuls, and their replies will appear here.

appeal_dm_closed.text: I cannot send you direct messages, so the appeal was not opened. Allow DMs from server members (privacy settings) and send /appeal again.

appeal_failed.text: Could not open the appeal. Try again later or contact the server staff.

appeal_not_member.text: Appeals are filed through the appeal server. Join it first, then send /appeal again: {invite}

appeal_note_condemned.text: Verdict: the appeal has been denied. The user has been notified and permanently banned on this server.

appeal_note_pardoned.text: Verdict: the appeal has been granted. The global unban request has been sent to Confederate Guard; the user has been notified and removed from this server.

appeal_thread_info.text: Appeal of {mention} ({username}, ID {id}). Messages in this thread are forwarded to the user's DM; senders are shown to them anonymously as consuls.

appeal_user_condemned.text: Your appeal has been reviewed and denied. The decision is final.

appeal_user_pardoned.text: Your appeal has been granted: the network bans have been lifted. You have been removed from the appeal server — you no longer need it.

atb_already_attached.text: This chat is already attached to a bridge.

atb_attached.text: The chat has been attached to bridge {bridge_id}.

backup_private_only.text: Use this command in a private chat with the bot.

bot_joined.text: The bot has joined the bridge.

bridge_info.not_in_bridge.text: This chat is not attached to a bridge.

bridge_join.text: Chat {channel} from {server} has joined the bridge.

bridge_leave.text: Chat {channel} from {server} has been removed from the bridge.

bskyfeed_attached.text: The Bluesky account {name} (@{account}) is now attached to {where}. Its new posts will be relayed there, including to chats that join later.

bskyfeed_invalid_account.text: That is not a Bluesky account. Give a handle, @handle, a link to the profile or a DID.

bskyfeed_rem_usage.text: Usage: /rembskyfeed <Bluesky account> — handle, @handle, a link to the profile or a DID.

bskyfeed_removed.text: Posts from @{account} are no longer relayed here.

bskyfeed_throttled.text: Bluesky is rate-limiting the bot right now, so @{account} could not be read. Try again in a few minutes.

bskyfeed_unreachable.text: Could not read @{account}. The account may be missing or deleted, or Bluesky is not answering right now.

bskyfeed_usage.text: Usage: /setbskyfeed <Bluesky account> — handle, @handle, a link to the profile or a DID.

chat_not_in_bridge.text: This chat is not attached to any bridge.

consent_body.text: This chat is connected to others. Your messages will be automatically relayed to the linked chats. If you edit or delete your message within 30 days of sending it, it will automatically be updated or disappear in the other chats too. Press "Accept" to agree to the relaying and keep chatting. See the chat description or the pinned message for details.

deadchat_disabled.text: Deadchat has been disabled for this channel.

deadchat_invalid_hours.text: Specify the duration in hours (greater than 0).

deadchat_invalid_role.text: role_id must be a numeric role ID or 'disable'.

deadtopic.enabled.text: Topic keep-alive has been enabled. Every 6 days without activity, at midnight UTC, the bot will send and delete a phantom message.

deadtopic.phantom_message.text: Phantom message to keep the topic alive.

feed_scope_bridge.text: bridge {bridge_id} and every chat of it

feed_scope_chat.text: this chat (it is in no bridge yet — once it joins one, the posts go to every chat of that bridge)

feed_stale_note.text: Note: the newest post the source offers for @{account} is from {date}. The source looks like it has not moved in a long while; until it does, there is nothing here to relay.

force_leave_not_member.text: The bot is not on that server.

force_leave_success_discord.text: The bot has left server {guild_id}; the server's data has been removed from the database.

force_leave_success_telegram.text: The bot has left Telegram chat {chat_id} (or its data has been removed from the database).

group_only.text: This command is only available in a group.

help.cmd_allow_bots.text: /allow-bots enable|disable — allow or forbid relaying messages from bots

help.cmd_allow_bots_tg.text: /allow_bots enable|disable — allow or forbid relaying messages from bots

help.cmd_allow_files.text: /allow-files enable|disable [local] — allow or forbid re-uploading Telegram files to Discord (server-wide, or `local` for this bridge)

help.cmd_allow_files_tg.text: /allow_files enable|disable [local] — allow or forbid re-uploading Telegram files to Discord (group-wide, or `local` for this bridge)

help.cmd_appeal.text: /appeal — file a ban appeal (after joining the appeal server)

help.cmd_atb.text: /atb <bridge_id> — attach this chat to a bridge (bot admins)

help.cmd_backup.text: /backup — get a backup of the database (bot admins)

help.cmd_bridge.text: /bridge — information about the bridge and attached chats

help.cmd_deadchat.text: /deadchat <role> <hours> | disable — ping a role on inactivity (Discord only)

help.cmd_deadtopic.text: /deadtopic enable|disable — once every 6 days without activity, send a phantom message to keep the topic alive

help.cmd_force_leave.text: /force_leave <platform> <id> — remove the bot from a chat (bot admins)

help.cmd_lang.text: /lang <code> — set the bot's default language for the whole server/group (bridge admins)

help.cmd_list_chats.text: /list_chats — list of all the bot's chats (bot admins)

help.cmd_loc_compare.text: /loc-compare <code> — compare a reply's translations across languages

help.cmd_loc_reply.text: /loc-reply <code> <text> — reply to a localization suggestion (bot admins)

help.cmd_locale.text: /locale [code] — localization status or the file of the chosen language

help.cmd_localizer_add.text: /localizer-add <user> — grant Localizer status: localization editing via the control panel (bot admins)

help.cmd_localizer_add_tg.text: /localizer-add <ID | @username | reply> — grant Localizer status: localization editing via the control panel (bot admins)

help.cmd_localizer_rem.text: /localizer-rem <user> — revoke a delegated Localizer status (bot admins)

help.cmd_localizer_rem_tg.text: /localizer-rem <ID | @username | reply> — revoke a delegated Localizer status (bot admins)

help.cmd_locallang.text: /locallang <code> — set the bot's language for this channel/topic (ru, uk, pl, en, es, pt)

help.cmd_mention.text: /mention <user> — mention a Discord user from another bridge community (1-hour cooldown per user)

help.cmd_newschat.text: /newschat add <emoji> | disable — auto-react to messages in a news channel (Discord only)

help.cmd_poll.text: /poll <text> <duration> <options> — anonymous poll in all bridge chats

help.cmd_privacy.text: /privacy — decide what the bot may share about you

help.cmd_remadmin.text: /remadmin <user> [local] — take Bridge Admin rights away, across this server/group or in this bridge alone

help.cmd_rembskyfeed.text: /rembskyfeed <account> — stop relaying a Bluesky account into this bridge

help.cmd_remindrules.text: /remindrules <duration> [messages] — periodically publish the rules in all bridge chats (e.g.: 2h, 30m)

help.cmd_remlocaladmin.text: /remlocaladmin <user> — revoke delegated local administrator rights (bot admins)

help.cmd_remtgfeed.text: /remtgfeed <channel> — stop relaying a Telegram channel into this bridge

help.cmd_remytfeed.text: /remytfeed <channel> — stop relaying a YouTube channel into this bridge

help.cmd_rfb.text: /rfb — detach this chat from the bridge

help.cmd_setadmin.text: /setadmin <user> [local] — make someone a Bridge Admin of every bridge of this server/group, or of this bridge alone

help.cmd_setbskyfeed.text: /setbskyfeed <account> — relay a public Bluesky account into this bridge

help.cmd_setlocaladmin.text: /setlocaladmin <user> — delegate local administrator rights over the whole server/group (bot admins)

help.cmd_setname.text: /setname [name] [user] — set the alias appellants see instead of “Consul A” (consuls; without a name it resets, `user` is Bot Admins only)

help.cmd_settgfeed.text: /settgfeed <channel> — relay a public Telegram channel into this bridge

help.cmd_setytfeed.text: /setytfeed <channel> — relay a public YouTube channel into this bridge

help.cmd_shadowban.text: /shadow-ban <user> — hide a user's messages from relaying

help.cmd_verify_list.text: /verify-list enable|disable — publish the IDs of (un)verified users to the sync channels for Confederate Guard (bot admins)

help.cmd_webhooks.text: /webhooks enable|disable [scope: local] — show relayed messages as webhooks (sender's avatar and name), server-wide or for this bridge only

help.cmd_whois.text: /whois — information about a message's author (as a reply to a bot relay message)
